Entries.Text: Display Groups
Display Groups
A map object is drawn while any of its draw groups is shown; standing on a collision shows that collision's display groups. Map objects with no draw groups are always drawn.

Suggest From Nearby

Give each target the groups the map objects around it agree on. Useful after placing or moving map objects. Neighbours come from the same map and are measured between their bounding boxes, so an asset inside a map piece counts as touching it.
Neighbours: {0}
How many of the nearest map objects vote. Each vote weighs 1 / (1 + distance in metres), so closer map objects count for more.
Agreement: {0}
How much of the neighbours' weight a group needs to be kept. Lower gives more groups; higher gives only the groups nearly all neighbours share. If no group reaches it, the best-supported one is kept.
Also suggest display groups for collisions
For collision targets, also replace their display groups with what the nearest collisions show.
Assign Groups From Nearby

Replace every target's draw groups with the groups its nearest map objects agree on. A map object with a Collision Name changes its collision's groups, judged by the collision's position. One undo step.

Groups

The groups used by the loaded maps.

Shown: whether the viewport shows the group. Drag down the ticks to set several the same way.
Drawn: map objects drawn while the group is shown.
Shown By: collisions that show the group while the player stands on them.

Click a count to select those map objects.

Which version of the groups the viewport tests. The game's map loader can swap or merge in each map object's alternate groups, depending on a game state; pick a state to preview what the game would show. Edits always change the stored groups.
Stored Groups
The groups exactly as stored in the map, without the loader's changes.
As Loaded: Merged

The loader's state byte at 0, the value the game starts with. Map objects with Use Alternate Groups ON (and No Alternate Group Merge OFF) merge their alternate groups in through the masks. Collisions also draw in their display groups.
As Loaded: Alternate

The loader's state byte at 1. Map objects with Use Alternate Groups ON use their alternate display groups instead of their display groups. Collisions also draw in their display groups. Which game state sets this is unknown.
As Loaded: No Alternate
The loader's state byte at 0xFF: alternate groups are ignored. Collisions still draw in their display groups.
Which of the targets' group arrays the list's edit columns change.
Edit: Draw and Display Groups
The draw and display groups. A map object with a Collision Name edits its collision's.
Edit: Alternate Groups
Each selected map object's own alternate draw and display groups, used when Use Alternate Groups is ON.
Edit: Alternate Group Masks
Each selected map object's own masks: when merging, the bits set here keep the stored value, and the rest come from the alternate groups.
Edit: Backread Groups
Each selected map object's own backread groups, which the game uses for loading. The viewport doesn't use them.
Edit: Navmesh Groups
Each selected map object's own navmesh groups. The viewport doesn't use them.
